import json
prog = currentProgram
out = {}
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x142268a30")
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
f = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr)
out["containing"] = (str(f.getName()), str(f.getEntryPoint()), str(f.getBody())) if f else None
addr2 = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x1422686c6")
f2 = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr2)
out["containing_2686c6"] = (str(f2.getName()), str(f2.getEntryPoint()), str(f2.getBody())) if f2 else None
# functions with despawn in name
it = fm.getFunctions(True)
cnt = 0
for fn in it:
    nm = fn.getName()
    if 'despawn' in nm.lower() and 'tree' in nm.lower():
        out.setdefault('despawn_funcs', []).append((nm, str(fn.getEntryPoint()), str(fn.getBody())))
        cnt += 1
out["count"] = cnt
print(json.dumps(out))
